explanation: The volume is V(t)=100+2t, so overflow begins at t=30 minutes. Salt mass satisfies S'=6−4S/(100+2t), S(0)=25. Solving gives S(t)=100+2t−750000/(100+2t)². Thus S(30)=130.703125 lb, rounding to 130.7 lb. This tests a scalar mixing differential equation, absent from the supplied course topics, so it is prerequisite.
